results.title: 小鼠视觉皮层：相似响应连接规则、几何对照与 RNN 消融
results.summary: MICrONS 的小鼠视觉皮层数据支持兴奋性神经元的相似响应连接偏好；需区分轴突几何与单突触选择。论文RNN消融提供功能线索，但不能证明同规则对LLM普遍有效。
assumptions: species: single mouse visual cortex; excitatory neurons across layers 2-5 and areas
measurement: matched calcium responses and EM; model-derived functional tuning
controls: same-region and axon-dendrite proximity controls
ai_model: vanilla RNN with 1000 hidden units on image classification

results.title: 果蝇 FlyWire：全脑结构图的版本、阈值与缺失边界
results.summary: 成体雌性果蝇 FlyWire 提供可导航的神经元与化学突触图；论文分析绑定版本783，连接阈值与突触附着完整度会改变图统计，结构图不提供完整动力学。
assumptions: species: adult female Drosophila melanogaster; single specimen
data_version: FlyWire materialization 783 as analysed in paper
graph_rule: default analysed connection threshold at least 5 synapses

results.title: 章鱼双阶段睡眠：状态与皮肤模式可观测，梦和巩固功能仍待验证
results.summary: Octopus laqueus 的行为干预与脑内记录支持静息/活跃睡眠两阶段；活跃睡眠出现醒样神经活动和皮肤模式，不直接证明做梦、记忆重放或学习收益。
assumptions: method: sleep deprivation/arousal tests; Neuropixels LFP; skin video embeddings
anatomy: sampled supra-oesophageal central brain; not entire arm nervous system
claim_scope: sleep states and wake-like patterns; no dream report or causal learning test
